title: Yeast Cells as Antioxidant-Producing Probiotics
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of Baker's yeast extractions , probiotic antioxidant, in scavenging the oxidative stress status mediated damage on sperm motility,progressive motility and vitality as well as comparing this potency to that of Vitamin E in infertile men.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* must have been married for 1 year before inclusion into the study and were unable to achieve pregnancy
* must have not received an antibiotic treatment for the last 4 weeks prior to sampling
* showed oxidative stress- mediated asthenozoospermia in their semen

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe male Factor
